backtest_protocol.execution_model: SPY, IWM, TLT, XLE, XLP, XLU, and candidate stock features are computed from OHLCV rows with Date <= signal_date. Rolling factor betas are fit on the 60 trading-day period ending 20 sessions before signal date; the 20-day residual leadership window ends at signal date. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Rejected. Available-proxy residual leadership did not add robust replacement value versus accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators after next-open execution, costs, cooldown, and concentration checks (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, drawdown_drift_too_high, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). The relation likely still relabels crowded recent-winner demand or misses old_thin factor behavior rather than creating an independent candidate-pool edge.

2_history_check.exp-20260614-006: Rejected correlation-breakdown idiosyncratic leader. That run used industry/correlation context and failed old_thin/drawdown; this run uses broad market/rate/sector proxy residualization.
2_history_check.exp-20260620-020: Measured core stack market/style beta using SPY/QQQ/IWM proxies; it was diagnostic and did not test a stock-level factor-residual candidate source.
2_history_check.exp-20260621-002: Rejected SPY trend-down beta hedge. This run is candidate-pool selection, not a portfolio hedge or risk-allocation overlay.
2_history_check.exp-20260621-003: Blocked because MTUM/QUAL/VLUE/USMV/SIZE were absent from the production-visible OHLCV warehouse. This run deliberately uses SPY/IWM/TLT/XLE/XLP/XLU, which are present in the warehouse.
2_history_check.novelty_gate: Novelty gate warned on idiosyncratic-leader near neighbors. The override records the new evidence axis: only production-visible warehouse OHLCV proxy tickers with full three-window coverage, unlike exp-20260621-003's missing factor ETF surface.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: exp-20260621-003 was blocked because MTUM/QUAL/VLUE/USMV/SIZE were not production-visible in the main OHLCV warehouse. This run uses only SPY/IWM/TLT/XLE/XLP/XLU, which are free, warehouse-backed, and available across the three canonical windows.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing SPY/IWM/TLT/XLE/XLP/XLU OHLCV, insufficient beta-fit history, missing candidate OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same available proxy reference context, PIT rolling beta fit, residual leadership gate, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
